stem.en: Kabir suggests a coin ten times bigger than ATP, "so you need fewer of them". What does the shop do?

text.en: Most jobs are far smaller than the new coin, so most of each coin is wasted as heat. The shop runs hotter and gets no more work done. A coin that is too big is the glucose note again, only less so.
Runs better with fewer coins to count.

feedback.en: Nobody counts. Every coin is spent whole, so a big coin on a small job is waste.
Energy paid is not energy used. The leftover from each job is heat, and there is more leftover per job with a bigger coin.

text.en: Cannot run because the coin is too heavy.

feedback.en: Weight is not the issue in a shop of molecules. Matching the job is.

explanation.en: Waste per job is coin size minus job size. Smaller coins, less waste. The limit is a coin so small that nothing useful can be bought with it, and ATP sits near the sweet spot.
